title: Ubiquiti U7 Pro XG Ceiling-Mounted 6-Stream Wi-Fi 7 Access Point $331.50 Delivered @ Mwave
body:

[theHMASfriendship] That is such a relief the bargains on this site are relentless
[ncoll36] CODE FREEZE - Purchase $900 and Get $120 Instant Discount [freeze20]
[oobadeedee] I would've pounced on this 6mths ago. But more and more I've been reading these are less reliable than the U6 pros, and can have heating issues.
[lawyerz] I read the issues with the u7pro, this is the XG version, very very solid for me.
[opt] Had two U7 Pros running for a little over two years with zero hardware or heat-related issues. There have been a few buggy firmware releases, but there have also been many stable releases too. If you pick and choose the right version with a bit of research, they are excellent APs. I get between 500 Mbps and 1 Gbps (capped by my network hardware: UCGU and switches) throughout my home across multiple walls and also outside.
[lawyerz] Amex has a spend $300 get $30 mwave ending 30/SEP/26
[mxlmxlmxl] have three of these. Rock solid. Paired with an XG switch they're perfect. 10Gbe + POE++ as well. Get 1,600 Mbps on iPhone in same room - and pretty much 800+Mbps anywhere in house.
[lawyerz] Which switch? I can't swallow the price of the UniFi Pro XG 8 Port at $1k..
[mxlmxlmxl] You won't like this answer then… USW-Pro-XG-48-PoE UniFi 48-port
I have a 10port and a standard 24 port but used all the ports - so it made sense (Ubiquiti logic sense, not real world sense) to get the 48 port.
[Spizz] Nice. I’m trying to just get the XG 10 to use with a pro max 16 Poe in the rack and an aggregation switch and call it a day.
[mhaqs] Except, it's not $1k right now. Mwave has a further 5% off going on right now, which puts the https://www.mwave.com.au/products/ubiquiti-pro-xg-8-poe-ac86… price at $926.25, before the FREEZE120 coupon.
Apply the FREEZE120 to get it down to $806, which would be an ATL for this switch and probably worth it in Ubiquiti world, if you want a managed POE++ 10G switch. The 10 port one would fall to $1126 (IMO a better deal, if you know what copper 10g switches need for cooling).
[netsurfer] 1600 Mbps is due to Apple's unwillingness to allow 320Mhz channel width. With XG, you want to use a proper WiFi 7 device that supports 320MHz. You want to get 3000 Mbps in the same room otherwise it defeats the purpose of going 10Gbps uplink.
[PlagueistheCheap] Is there benefit to using the ubiquiti switch to the AP? I have the udr7 and a u6pro. The u6pro is getting its poe off a tplink switch as there is only one Ethernet port upstairs and I want to run the console and TV on lan. I think I only get 500 in the same room as the u6 pro
[JoeTripodi] Just grabbed one thanks. I have 2 of these already and they are great, this is going in the garage which is a black spot for signal.
[frankfu1122] Thanks, got the Ubiquiti Flex 8-Port 2.5 GbE PoE++ Switch with 10G RJ45/SFP+ with uplink was a pretty good deal. Stacked with Amex 300 get 30 offer.
